title: Playing kazoo clarinet and bass drum
summary: In the boys' band he played a clarinet-shaped kazoo and alternated with bass drum, inspired by a loud drummer and Manuel Perez's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: What did you play in that little band?
Well in that little band I used to play the clarinet.

No, there was no real clarinet but it was a kazoo made in the shape of a clarinet. Oh I see. And then too I used to alternate from the clarinet to the bass drum, because I used to like to beat the bass drums. And one particular fella around there at that time, I used to call him, I don't remember his name, but you could hear him beat that bass drum miles and miles off and I was more or less inspired there too. And of course this was during the time that when Manuel Perez had his great band. I don't know whether you remember.
